youtube.title: Why Headphone Cords Always Tangle 🎧 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Leave a pair of headphones loose in a pocket or bag and they come out knotted. In a 2007 University of California San Diego experiment, researchers tumbled strings of different lengths in a box and filmed them. Nearly half of the strings knotted within ten seconds, and longer, floppier strings knotted more often. Random motion lets the cord loop and thread through itself.
